description: NK NEXOBOTS, NK Bilim ve Sanat Akademisi bünyesinde bilim, teknoloji ve uzay merakını yaratıcı projelere dönüştürmek amacıyla kurulan bir öğrenci takımıdır. Robotik kodlama, tasarım ve problem çözme çalışmalarımızı.Kodlama, uzay bilimleri, oyun tasarımı, görsel tasarım ve hikâye anlatımına ilgi duyan; araştırmayı, üretmeyi ve birlikte öğrenmeyi seven takım arkadaşları arıyoruz. summary:
Space Discovery Mission is an educational space exploration game designed by the NK NEXOBOTS team for primary school students.

The project aims to make learning about the Solar System more engaging through interactive questions, rocket-launch timing, and planet discovery.

In the proposed gameplay, a rocket rotates around Earth while a question about a planet appears on the screen. The player identifies the correct planet and launches the rocket at the right moment. A successful launch reveals an educational information card about the planet and allows the player to progress to the next level.

The game combines astronomy education with decision-making, attention, and hand-eye coordination. Increasing difficulty across levels is intended to encourage students to learn through exploration and experimentation.

Our goal is to inspire young learners to become curious about space science while gaining experience in educational game design.
details:
Space Discovery Mission – Project Details

1. Project Overview

Space Discovery Mission is an educational game project developed around the idea of learning astronomy through interactive space exploration.

The project is designed for primary school students and aims to transform traditional planet-related questions into an engaging mission-based learning experience.

2. How the Game Works

The proposed game begins with a rocket rotating around Earth. A question about a planet appears on the screen.

The player must identify the planet described in the question and choose the correct moment to launch the rocket.

If the rocket reaches the correct destination, an educational information card introduces scientific facts about the planet, such as its position in the Solar System, physical characteristics, or other interesting features.

The player can then advance to another level. Later levels are designed to introduce more challenging targets and questions.

3. Problem and Solution

Many young students learn about the Solar System mainly by reading and memorizing information. This can make astronomy seem difficult or abstract.

Our solution is to combine educational content with gameplay, visual feedback, and interactive decision-making.

Instead of simply answering a multiple-choice question, students participate in a space mission and discover information through their actions.

4. Educational Benefits

The project aims to support:

  • Basic knowledge of the Solar System
  • Scientific curiosity and exploration
  • Attention and timing skills
  • Decision-making and problem-solving
  • Learning through interactive experiences

5. Development Approach

The project combines a game concept, space-themed visual design, educational planet questions, and an interactive user experience.

The planned gameplay includes rotating rocket movement, launch controls, collision detection, scoring, information cards, and progressively challenging levels.

The final prototype and its technical implementation are documented through the links provided in the project submission.

6. Creativity and Innovation

The main creative feature is the combination of planet-related questions with a timing-based rocket-launch mechanic.

Students must both understand the scientific question and interact with the game to reach the correct destination.

Our aim is to make space science accessible, enjoyable, and memorable for younger learners.

7. Future Development

Future improvements may include additional missions, fuel management, limited launch attempts, new planetary science questions, and more advanced mission challenges.
